featured.description: Reference plugin shipped by the Sisyphus team. Provides the Chat view, Canvas preview (Sandpack), Settings panel, and three demo agents (react-designer, time-helper, assistant). Recommended first install for any fresh Sisyphus.
featured.author: Sisyphus

featured.description: Rule-based todo manager with persistence. Demonstrates a non-LLM agent, custom card payloads, and the side-pane view extension surface. Good template if you want to build a deterministic agent that owns a small piece of UI state.
featured.author: Sisyphus
